summary: Context-only committee read: the headline tape is risk-on and the risk radar is calm/receding, but this is not a clean all-clear. The confirmed US regime remains Q2 Reflation at low confidence (0.218) even though its current axes read raw Q3: growth -0.267 and inflation +0.36, with only 1 of 7 confirmation sessions complete. Liquidity is contracting in an orderly, non-stressed drain; credit is healthy and tight; volatility is normalizing; breadth remains broadly intact above the 200-day measure, although the latest session had more decliners than advancers. No market-recovery confirmation chip is fresh, so the recovery context should not be described as confirmed. Factor intelligence is immature: only 10 panel dates, no Pair G records, no factor-attention grading history, no scorecard survivors, and the composite is non-tradeable. This memo annotates existing evidence only and originates no signal, ranking, trade, or probability.

Separately, the regime label is internally stale relative to its axes: confirmed Q2 versus raw Q3. The factor contradiction ledger is dormant, so absence means insufficient history rather than agreement. Review of the master-brain ledger found many open theses past their check_by dates. That is conflicted context, not validation of either side.
